==Description==
The '''Confusion Ducky''' is one of the five duckies spawned by the [[Ducky Squad]] consumable. It has a low amount of health and creates an explosion upon death.

Upon death, the '''Confusion Ducky''' will create an explosion which deals 100 damage to all enemies hit in its explosion radius of 6. This explosion can damage [[Lead (Attribute)|Lead]] enemies, bypasses defense and has no damage drop off. Any enemy hit by the explosion will also have confusion applied to them, making them go backwards for between 3 and 1 seconds. The confusion time is based on enemy size. Affected enemies cannot be confused for the next 8 seconds.

==Appearance==
The '''Confusion Ducky''' is a regular yellow duck with black eyes, orange beak and orange flippers. It wears a purple cap and grey shades. It has three animations that it can randomly have, where all three also have differently shaped eyes. The first animation has it have a happy expression, the second has it have a serious expression while the third one has its eyes partially closed, likely because it is scared.

==Strategy==
*The '''Confusion Ducky''' can be used to stall enemies quite well, as none of them are immune to confusion.
**Even [[Boss]] enemies are not immune due to a bug.
**However, confusion time is based on enemy size. The larger the enemy, the shorter they get confused for.
*The '''Confusion Ducky''' can be used to deal with weaker hordes of enemies, as it deals decent splash damage.
